topic: Area of Study 3: Music for Film
subject: music

moments.title: King Kong score
moments.body: Steiner's symphonic score sets the template for Golden Age Hollywood music.

moments.title: Star Wars
moments.body: Williams's score, recorded by the LSO, revives the symphonic blockbuster.
moments.takeaway: Film music revived orchestral writing for mass audiences.

moments.title: Hildur Gudnadottir wins Oscar
moments.body: Gudnadottir becomes only the third woman to win an original score Oscar.
moments.takeaway: Major film scoring is still mostly male-dominated.

now.title: Film music today
now.body: TV scoring (Cuarron, Reznor) blurs cinema and television soundtracks. Video game music reaches concert hall.
now.open_questions: What is the next platform that will reshape scoring?

reflection: Most listeners hear more orchestral music in cinemas than in concert halls.
